### A Reflection of God’s Glory
Author: Susanne Scheppmann
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-sept-26-2008-11582200.html
Passage: Psalm 104:24, 31
Points:
- Stress and daily busyness often blind people to the beauty of God's creation.
- God gave humans physical senses so they could perceive His character in the world around them.
- The Lord exercises complete authority over nature, sustaining and providing for every creature.
- Observing God's constant care for creation strengthens faith in His personal care for us.
- Taking time outside offers a direct opportunity to reflect on God and offer Him praise.

### Wisdom from the Psalms 8/19
Author: Wisdom from the Psalms
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-8-or-19-552518.html
Passage: Psalm 104:24
Points:
- Familiar or seemingly ordinary parts of nature can ignite deep wonder when examined closely.
- The created earth functions as a vast storehouse filled with divine craftsmanship.
- Believers are called to take time to study and enjoy the works God has made.
- Seeking out God's riches in creation protects the heart from spiritual poverty.
- Prayer helps believers maintain a fresh appreciation for God's ongoing miracles in the world.
